mapper.sql: id, url, label, enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at, last_run_at, last_status, last_message, schedule_enabled, schedule_interval_minutes, schedule_mode, schedule_cron, next_run_at, robots_allowed, robots_checked_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crawl_target WHERE enabled = TRUE AND schedule_enabled = TRUE AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= now() ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_target (url, label, enabled, created_by, schedule_enabled, schedule_interval_minutes, schedule_mode, schedule_cron, next_run_at) VALUES (#{url}, #{label}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{scheduleEnabled}, #{scheduleIntervalMinutes}, #{scheduleMode}, #{scheduleCron}, #{nextRunAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_target SET url = #{url}, label = #{label}, enabled = #{enabled}, schedule_enabled = #{scheduleEnabled}, schedule_interval_minutes = #{scheduleIntervalMinutes}, schedule_mode = #{scheduleMode}, schedule_cron = #{scheduleCron}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crawl_target SET last_run_at = now(), last_status = #{status}, last_message = #{message}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE crawl_target SET schedule_enabled = #{scheduleEnabled}, schedule_interval_minutes = #{scheduleIntervalMinutes}, schedule_mode = #{scheduleMode}, schedule_cron = #{scheduleCron}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crawl_target SET robots_allowed = #{allowed}, robots_checked_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crawl_target SET next_run_at = now() + (#{intervalMinutes} * interval '1 minute'), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crawl_target SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, target_id, url, title, content, url_hash, content_hash, status, http_status, error_message, fetched_at, created_at FROM crawl_document WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND content_hash = #{contentHash} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY fetched_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_document (target_id, url, title, content, url_hash, content_hash, status, http_status, error_message, fetched_at) VALUES (#{targetId}, #{url}, #{title}, #{content}, #{urlHash}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{fetchedAt})

INSERT INTO crawl_run_log (target_id, document_id, status, failure_code, http_status, message, duration_ms) VALUES (#{targetId}, #{documentId}, #{status}, #{failureCode}, #{httpStatus}, #{message}, #{durationMs})
mapper.sql: id, target_id, document_id, status, failure_code, http_status, message, duration_ms, created_at, reviewed, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_run_log SET reviewed = TRUE, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = now(), review_comment = #{comment} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM crawl_run_log WHERE created_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT count(*) FROM crawl_document WHERE created_at < #{cutoff} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DUPLICATE')
